gen-silkscreen-gf-nanum-gothic: Silkscreen lays out chunky pixel letters with generous gaps between them, lo-fi and retro as an old arcade cabinet. And Nanum Gothic feels modern and sturdy beside it, its wide channels leading smoothly into each counter.
gen-silkscreen-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Silkscreen spells everything in blocky, unvarying strokes with a lo-fi, retro hum, loose and spaced out. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan does the quieter job, its terminals cut back to leave a big gap that keeps text easy to take in.
gen-silkscreen-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Silkscreen draws every letter with a flat, unvarying line, retro and pixel-bold. And Noto Sans Shavian carries a long read in rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends, so the text keeps moving.
gen-silkscreen-gf-philosopher: Pixel nostalgia, spaced out and lo-fi, comes from Silkscreen. But Philosopher is the real draw, with curves full of daylight and soft shifts in thickness, which turns that arcade look into something you could actually read for pages.
gen-silkscreen-gf-pt-sans: Silkscreen squeezes out its letters like toothpaste in one steady line, lo-fi and retro, with space between each. PT Sans brings the friendlier side, its open-arc c forms making the pair feel playful yet approachable.
gen-silkscreen-gf-red-hat-text: Silkscreen is all retro pixel charm, loosely spaced and lo-fi. Red Hat Text sits beneath with the fine line of a technical drawing pen and curvy, unclamped letters, so the blocky top and the modern body settle in together.
gen-silkscreen-gf-reddit-sans: Nostalgic pixel letters come from Silkscreen, spaced out like spaghetti and unmistakably lo-fi. Reddit Sans then takes over for the running text, with a wide gap at the e's terminal and a line that never shifts thickness, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-silkscreen-gf-roboto-flex: Retro pixels with room to breathe: that's Silkscreen, lo-fi and signage-plain in every line. But shrink it too far and the gaps get fussy, while Roboto Flex, with its wide slot between the c's two ends, handles bigger sizes happily.
gen-silkscreen-gf-rosario: Silkscreen is retro and lo-fi, flat at the sides of every bowl. Rosario follows with ends of the c that never turn inward, giving the blocky headline a friendly, contemporary partner on the page.
